signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.emailIntro: Enter your email and we'll send you a code to sign in. If you're new, this creates your account.
signIn.codeIntro: We sent a six-digit code to {{email}}. Type it here, or open the link in the email.
signIn.codeResent: We sent you a new code.
signIn.openAppHelp: If the app is installed, it opens and signs you in. Otherwise continue in the browser.
signIn.linkHelp: Links work once and expire after 10 minutes. Ask for a new code to try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.displayNamePlaceholder: How friends and family see you
settings.sessionsIntro: Sign out any device you no longer use.
settings.deleteWarning: This permanently deletes your account and everything in it. It can't be undone.

errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

lists.title: Your lists
lists.name: List name
lists.empty: Nothing here yet. Add the first thing you'd like.
lists.defaultExplained: This is your default list. You can rename it, but not delete it.
lists.deleteWarning_zero: This deletes the list. It can't be undone.
lists.deleteWarning_one: This deletes the list and its {{count}} item. It can't be undone.
lists.deleteWarning_other: This deletes the list and its {{count}} items. It can't be undone.
lists.addExistingIntro: Everything you've added lives on your default list. Pick what should also be on this one; editing an item later changes it on every list.
lists.nothingToAdd: Everything you have is already on this list.

items.name: Name
items.descriptionPlaceholder: Size, colour, where to find it…
items.rating: How much do you want it?
items.ratingHelp: Tap a star; tap it again to clear.
items.pictureFailed: The picture couldn't be uploaded, so nothing was saved.
items.pictureFailedKept: The item was saved, but its picture couldn't be uploaded. Press Save to try the picture again.
items.pictureFailedEdit: Your changes were saved, but the picture couldn't be uploaded.
items.urlInvalid: Enter a full link, starting with https://
items.deleteWarning: Delete “{{name}}” from all your lists? It can't be undone.
items.sharedWarning: Someone may already have bought this. Continue?
items.listsHelp: Choose every list this item should be on. It always stays on your default list.
items.autofillDone: Filled in from the shop. Check the details before saving.
items.autofillNothing: This shop didn't share its details. The link is kept; type the rest.
items.autofillBlocked: The shop blocked Strena from reading this page. The link is kept; type the rest.
items.autofillTimeout: The shop took too long to answer. The link is kept; type the rest or try again later.
items.autofillUnreachable: Strena couldn't reach this shop. Check the link; it's kept, so you can type the rest.
items.autofillUnreadable: Strena couldn't read this page. The link is kept; type the rest.
items.autofillNotPublic: Strena won't open this link: it points to an address that isn't on the public internet. The link is kept; type the rest.
items.nameGuessed: Guessed from the link, since the shop's page couldn't be read. Check it before saving.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.intro: Each person gets their own link. They can see this list and quietly mark what they're getting; you'll never see what's taken.
sharing.linkOnce: Send it to them now: for safety it's shown only once. If it gets lost, stop sharing and add them again.
sharing.isShared: Shared with people who have a link.
sharing.notShared: Only you can see this list.

shared.signInToReserve: Sign in to see what's already taken and to mark what you'll get. {{owner}} won't see it.
shared.joinExplained: Add this list to your Shared with me to mark what you'll get.
shared.ownerNote: This is your list. This is what people with the link see; what they reserve stays hidden from you.
shared.empty: This list is empty for now.
shared.secret: {{name}} can't see what anyone is getting.
shared.cancel: I won't get it after all

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.email: You get an email when a list is shared with you, or when something you're getting changes.
notifications.denied: Notifications are turned off for Strena in this phone's settings.
notifications.web: Phone notifications are available in the Strena app.
notifications.simulator: Phone notifications need a real phone.
notifications.not-configured: Phone notifications aren't set up in this build of the app yet.

add.title: Add from a link
add.noLink: There's no web link to add here.

look.title: Pick a look
look.darkExplained: In dark mode the app uses the Chalkboard look.
